title.zh: 卷一百四十八 志第一百〇一 儀衞六
title.raw: 卷一百四十八 志第一百〇一 儀衞六 Volume 148 Treatises 101: Ceremonial Guards 6

sentences.zh: 儀衛六○鹵簿儀服。

translations.literal: Ceremonial Guards 6 ○ Imperial Escort Ceremonial Regalia.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial Guards 6: Imperial Escort Ceremonial Regalia.

sentences.zh: 鹵簿儀服。

translations.literal: Imperial escort ceremonial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial regalia of the imperial escort.

sentences.zh: 自漢鹵簿，象最在前。

translations.literal: From the Han imperial escort onward, elephants were placed foremost.
translations.idiomatic: In the Han imperial escort and thereafter, elephants led the procession.

sentences.zh: 晉平吳後，南越獻馴象，作大車駕之，以載黃門鼓吹數十人，使越人騎之以試橋梁。

translations.literal: After Jin pacified Wu, Southern Yue presented tame elephants; a large carriage was made to harness them, carrying several dozen Yellow Gate musicians, and Yue men were made to ride them to test bridges.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin dynasty pacified Wu, Southern Yue presented tame elephants. A large carriage was built to harness them, carrying several dozen Yellow Gate musicians, and Yue men were sent to ride the elephants to test bridges.

sentences.zh: 宋鹵簿，以象居先，設木蓮花坐，金蕉盤，紫羅繡幨絡腦，當胸、後鞦並設銅鈴杏葉，紅犛牛尾拂，跋塵。

translations.literal: In the Song imperial escort, elephants were placed first; they were fitted with wooden lotus seats, golden plantain trays, purple silk embroidered trappings and head nets, copper bell apricot-leaf ornaments on the chest and rear crupper, red yak-tail dusters, and tail dusters.
translations.idiomatic: In the Song imperial escort, elephants led the way. Each was fitted with a wooden lotus seat and a golden plantain tray, with purple silk embroidered trappings and head nets, copper bell and apricot-leaf ornaments on the chest and crupper, red yak-tail dusters, and tail dusters.

sentences.zh: 每象，南越軍一人跨其上，四人引，並花腳襆頭、緋繡窄衣、銀帶。

translations.literal: For each elephant, one man of the Southern Yue army rode atop it while four men led it; all wore flowered-foot turbans, scarlet embroidered narrow jackets, and silver belts.
translations.idiomatic: For each elephant, one soldier from the Southern Yue army rode on its back while four men led it. All wore flowered-foot turbans, scarlet embroidered narrow jackets, and silver belts.

sentences.zh: 太宗太平興國六年，兩莊養象所奏，詔以象十於南郊引駕，開寶九年南郊時，其象止在六引前排列。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo under Emperor Taizong, the Two Estates Elephant-Rearing Office memorialized; an edict ordered ten elephants to lead the carriage at the Southern Suburban Sacrifice. At the Southern Suburban Sacrifice in the ninth year of Kaibao, the elephants were stationed only in ranks before the Six Guides.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo, Emperor Taizong received a memorial from the Two Estates Elephant-Rearing Office and ordered ten elephants to lead the imperial carriage at the Southern Suburban Sacrifice. At the Southern Suburban Sacrifice in the ninth year of Kaibao, the elephants were placed only in formation before the Six Guides.

sentences.zh: 詔鹵簿使領其事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Imperial Escort Commissioner to take charge of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the Imperial Escort Commissioner to oversee the matter.

sentences.zh: 旗，皆錯采為之，漆竿、鐏首、纛頭、錦帶腰、火焰腳。

translations.literal: Flags were all made with multi-colored weave, with lacquered poles, metal finials, pennant heads, brocade waist bands, and flame-shaped streamers.
translations.idiomatic: All flags were made in multi-colored weave, with lacquered poles, metal finials, pennant heads, brocade waist bands, and flame-shaped streamers.

sentences.zh: 白澤、攝提、金鸞、金鳳、師子、苣文、天下太平、君王萬歲、仙童、螣蛇、神龜，及在步甲前後隊、後馬隊三隊、六軍儀仗內，並以赤。

translations.literal: The White Ze, Sheti, Golden Luan, Golden Phoenix, Lion, Juwen, All Under Heaven at Peace, May the Sovereign Live Ten Thousand Years, Immortal Boy, Teng Snake, Divine Tortoise, and those in the front and rear foot-armor companies, the three rear cavalry companies, and within the Six Armies ceremonial guard—all used red.
translations.idiomatic: The White Ze, Sheti, Golden Luan, Golden Phoenix, Lion, Juwen, All Under Heaven at Peace, May the Sovereign Live Ten Thousand Years, Immortal Boy, Teng Snake, and Divine Tortoise flags, as well as those in the front and rear foot-armor companies, the three rear cavalry companies, and the Six Armies ceremonial guard, were all red.

sentences.zh: 日、月及合璧、連珠、風、雨、雷、電、五星、二十八宿、祥雲，並以青。

translations.literal: The Sun, Moon, Joined Discs, Linked Pearls, Wind, Rain, Thunder, Lightning, Five Stars, Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions, and Auspicious Clouds—all used green.
translations.idiomatic: The Sun, Moon, Joined Discs, Linked Pearls, Wind, Rain, Thunder, Lightning, Five Stars, Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions, and Auspicious Clouds flags were all green.

sentences.zh: 北斗以黑。

translations.literal: The Northern Dipper used black.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Dipper flag was black.

sentences.zh: 五嶽、四瀆、五方、四神、十二辰、五龍、五鳳、龍虎君，並以方色。

translations.literal: The Five Sacred Mountains, Four Rivers, Five Directions, Four Deities, Twelve Branches, Five Dragons, Five Phoenixes, and Dragon-Tiger Lord—all used the colors of their respective directions.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Sacred Mountains, Four Rivers, Five Directions, Four Deities, Twelve Branches, Five Dragons, Five Phoenixes, and Dragon-Tiger Lord flags all used the colors associated with their respective directions.

sentences.zh: 天王以赤、黃二色。

translations.literal: The Heavenly King used red and yellow.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly King flag used red and yellow.

sentences.zh: 排攔以黃、紫、赤三色。

translations.literal: The barrier flags used yellow, purple, and red.
translations.idiomatic: The barrier flags used yellow, purple, and red.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，詳定郊廟奉祀禮文所言：“鹵簿，前用二十八宿、五星、攝提旗，有司乃取方士之說，繪為人形，於禮無據。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, the office for determining suburban and temple sacrificial ritual texts stated: "In the imperial escort, the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions, Five Stars, and Sheti flags were used at the front, but the responsible officials took the theories of Daoist masters and painted them as human figures, which has no basis in ritual."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng, the office charged with determining suburban and temple sacrificial ritual texts reported: "In the imperial escort, the Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions, Five Stars, and Sheti flags were placed at the front, but the responsible officials had followed Daoist masters and painted them as human figures, which has no basis in ritual."

sentences.zh: 伏請改製，各著其象，以則天文。

translations.literal: I respectfully request that they be redesigned, each showing its proper emblem, to accord with the celestial patterns.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully request that they be redesigned so that each displays its proper emblem in accordance with the celestial patterns.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 元祐七年，太常寺言：“二十八宿旗，五星、攝提旗，按《鹵簿圖》畫人形及牛虎頭、婦人、小兒之類，於禮無據。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanyou, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "The Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions flags and the Five Stars and Sheti flags, according to the Imperial Escort Diagram, were painted as human figures and as ox heads, tiger heads, women, children, and the like, which has no basis in ritual."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanyou, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "The Twenty-eight Lunar Mansions flags and the Five Stars and Sheti flags, as shown in the Imperial Escort Diagram, were painted as human figures, ox and tiger heads, women, children, and the like, which has no basis in ritual."

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，禮文所上言乞改製，各著其象，以則天文。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, the ritual texts office submitted a request to redesign them, each showing its proper emblem to accord with the celestial patterns.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng, the ritual texts office had submitted a request to redesign them so that each would display its proper emblem in accordance with the celestial patterns.

sentences.zh: 後有司循舊儀，未曾改正，今欲改造。”

translations.literal: Later the responsible officials followed the old rites and never corrected them; now we wish to redesign them."
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the responsible officials continued to follow the old rites and never made the correction; we now wish to redesign them.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 元符二年，徽宗即位，兵部侍郎黃裳言：“南郊大駕諸旗名物，除用典故製號外，餘因時事取名。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfu, when Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, Vice Minister of War Huang Shang stated: "Among the flags and named objects of the Southern Suburban grand procession, aside from those made according to classical precedents, the rest were named according to current events."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanfu, when Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, Vice Minister of War Huang Shang reported: "Among the flags and named objects of the Southern Suburban grand procession, aside from those established according to classical precedents, the rest were named in response to current events."

sentences.zh: 伏見近者璽授元符，茅山之上日有重輪，太上老君眉間發紅光，武夷君廟有仙鶴，臣請製為旗號，曰寶符，曰重輪，曰祥光，曰瑞鶴。”

translations.literal: I have observed that recently the seal was conferred in Yuanfu, the sun on Mount Mao showed a double halo, red light issued from between the eyebrows of the Supreme Venerable Sovereign, and an immortal crane appeared at the temple of Lord Wuyi. I request that flags be made bearing the names Precious Talisman, Double Halo, Auspicious Radiance, and Auspicious Crane."
translations.idiomatic: I have observed that recently the seal was conferred in Yuanfu, the sun on Mount Mao displayed a double halo, red light shone from between the eyebrows of the Supreme Venerable Sovereign, and an immortal crane appeared at the temple of Lord Wuyi. I request that flags be made bearing the names Precious Talisman, Double Halo, Auspicious Radiance, and Auspicious Crane.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 政和四年，禮製局言：“鹵簿，大黃龍負圖旗畫八卦，乞改畫九、一、三、七、二、四、六、八、五之數。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenghe, the Ritual Regulations Bureau stated: "In the imperial escort, the Great Yellow Dragon Bearing the Diagram flag depicted the Eight Trigrams; we request that it be changed to depict the numbers nine, one, three, seven, two, four, six, eight, and five."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenghe, the Ritual Regulations Bureau reported: "In the imperial escort, the Great Yellow Dragon Bearing the Diagram flag depicted the Eight Trigrams. We request that it be changed to depict the numbers nine, one, three, seven, two, four, six, eight, and five."

sentences.zh: 仙童、網子、大神三旗無所經見，乞除去。”

translations.literal: The three flags Immortal Boy, Net Master, and Great Spirit have no precedent in the classics; we request their removal."
translations.idiomatic: The Immortal Boy, Net Master, and Great Spirit flags have no precedent in the classics; we request that they be removed.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 初，大觀三年，西京潁陽縣大慶觀聖祖殿東，有嘉禾、芝草並生。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the third year of Daguan, east of the Hall of the Sacred Ancestor at Daqing Abbey in Yingyang County of the Western Capital, auspicious grain and spirit fungus grew together.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the third year of Daguan, auspicious grain and spirit fungus grew together east of the Hall of the Sacred Ancestor at Daqing Abbey in Yingyang County of the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 其嘉禾一本四穗，芝草葉圓而重起。

translations.literal: The auspicious grain had one stalk with four ears, and the spirit fungus had round leaves that rose in layers.
translations.idiomatic: The auspicious grain had one stalk with four ears, and the spirit fungus had round leaves that rose in layered tiers.

sentences.zh: 至是，詔製芝禾並秀旗。

translations.literal: At this time, an edict ordered the making of the Spirit Fungus and Auspicious Grain Flourishing Together flag.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, an edict ordered the creation of the Spirit Fungus and Auspicious Grain Flourishing Together flag.

sentences.zh: 又以是年二月，日上生青、赤、黃戴氣；

translations.literal: Also in the second month of that year, green, red, and yellow coronae appeared above the sun;
translations.idiomatic: Also in the second month of that year, green, red, and yellow coronae appeared above the sun;

sentences.zh: 後，日下生青、赤、黃承氣，詔製日有戴承旗。

translations.literal: later green, red, and yellow supporting auras appeared below the sun, and an edict ordered the making of the Sun with Corona and Supporting Aura flag.
translations.idiomatic: later green, red, and yellow supporting auras appeared below the sun, and an edict ordered the creation of the Sun with Corona and Supporting Aura flag.

sentences.zh: 又以元符二年武夷君廟有仙鶴迎詔，政和二年延福宮宴輔臣，有群鶴自西北來，盤旋於睿謨殿上，及奏大晟樂而翔鶴屢至，詔製瑞鶴旗。

translations.literal: Also because in the second year of Yuanfu an immortal crane at the temple of Lord Wuyi welcomed an edict, and in the second year of Zhenghe, when ministers were feasted at Yanfu Palace, a flock of cranes came from the northwest and circled above Rui Mo Hall, and when the Dasheng music was performed flying cranes repeatedly arrived, an edict ordered the making of the Auspicious Crane flag.
translations.idiomatic: Also because in the second year of Yuanfu an immortal crane at the temple of Lord Wuyi welcomed an edict, and in the second year of Zhenghe, when ministers were feasted at Yanfu Palace, a flock of cranes came from the northwest and circled above Rui Mo Hall, and flying cranes repeatedly appeared when the Dasheng music was performed, an edict ordered the creation of the Auspicious Crane flag.

sentences.zh: 八年，禮部侍郎張邦昌奏：“太祖時，甘露降於江陵者十日，瑞麥秀於濮陽者六歧，獲金鸚鵡於隴坻，得三玉兔於鄆封，馴象至而五嶺平，瓊管族而白鹿出，皆命製為旗章陳之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Bangchang memorialized: "In the time of Emperor Taizu, sweet dew fell at Jiangling for ten days, auspicious wheat with six ears appeared at Puyang, a golden parrot was captured on the Long Plateau, three jade rabbits were obtained at Yun Prefecture, tame elephants arrived when the Five Ridges were pacified, and a white deer appeared when the Qiong tribes submitted—all were ordered made into flags and displayed."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Bangchang memorialized: "In the time of Emperor Taizu, sweet dew fell at Jiangling for ten days, auspicious wheat with six ears appeared at Puyang, a golden parrot was captured on the Long Plateau, three jade rabbits were obtained at Yun Prefecture, tame elephants arrived when the Five Ridges were pacified, and a white deer appeared when the Qiong tribes submitted. All of these were ordered made into flags and displayed."

sentences.zh: 望詔有司取自崇、觀至今，凡中外所上瑞應，悉掇其尤殊者，增製旗物，上以丕承天貺，下以聳動民瞻。”

translations.literal: I hope an edict will order the responsible officials to gather from the Chong and Guan reigns to the present all auspicious responses submitted from within and without, select the most extraordinary among them, and add new flags, thereby above greatly receiving Heaven's bounty and below stirring the people's admiration."
translations.idiomatic: I hope an edict will direct the responsible officials to gather from the Chong and Guan reigns to the present all auspicious responses submitted from within and without the court, select the most extraordinary among them, and add new flags, thereby above greatly receiving Heaven's bounty and below stirring the people's admiration.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 初，宋製旗物尢盛，中興後惟務簡約，雖參用舊制，然亦不無因革。

translations.literal: At first, Song flag regalia was especially elaborate; after the Restoration only simplicity was pursued. Although old regulations were still partly used, there were nonetheless changes.
translations.idiomatic: At first, Song flag regalia was especially elaborate; after the Restoration the court pursued only simplicity. Although old regulations were still partly used, there were nonetheless changes.

sentences.zh: 其太常，青質夾羅，惟繡日、月、星而無龍，下有網須謂之茀，而竿頭為龍首，銜青結綬，垂青旄緌十二，謂之旒。

translations.literal: The Grand Constant flag had a green double-layered gauze field, embroidered only with sun, moon, and stars and without dragons; below was a net fringe called the fu, while the pole head was a dragon head holding a green knotted cord from which hung twelve green yak-tail tassels called the liu.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Constant flag had a green double-layered gauze field, embroidered only with the sun, moon, and stars and without dragons. Below was a net fringe called the fu, while the pole head was a dragon head holding a green knotted cord from which hung twelve green yak-tail tassels called the liu.

sentences.zh: 蓋幅下無斿，而竿首垂旒，抑又取古者“注旄及羽於竿首”之遺製。

translations.literal: For although there were no streamers below the flag panel, tassels hung from the pole head—again adopting the ancient remnant practice of "fixing yak tails and feathers at the pole head."
translations.idiomatic: Although there were no streamers below the flag panel, tassels hung from the pole head, again adopting the ancient remnant practice of fixing yak tails and feathers at the pole head.

sentences.zh: 竿用椆木，護以剖竹，膠以髹，飾以藻，玉輅建之。

translations.literal: The pole was of zelkova wood, protected with split bamboo, lacquered, and ornamented with wave patterns; it was mounted on the Jade Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The pole was made of zelkova wood, protected with split bamboo, lacquered, and ornamented with wave patterns. It was mounted on the Jade Carriage.

sentences.zh: 大旂，黃質九幅，每幅繡升龍一，側幅二，下垂黃絲網緌九，金輅建之。

translations.literal: The Great Banner had a yellow field of nine panels, each panel embroidered with one ascending dragon, with two side panels, and nine yellow silk net tassels hanging below; it was mounted on the Gold Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Banner had a yellow field of nine panels, each embroidered with one ascending dragon, with two side panels and nine yellow silk net tassels hanging below. It was mounted on the Gold Carriage.

sentences.zh: 太赤，朱質七幅，每幅繡鳥隼二，側幅如之，下垂朱絲網緌七，象輅建之。

translations.literal: The Grand Red had a vermilion field of seven panels, each panel embroidered with two bird-hawks, with side panels likewise, and seven vermilion silk net tassels hanging below; it was mounted on the Elephant Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Red had a vermilion field of seven panels, each embroidered with two bird-hawks, with side panels likewise and seven vermilion silk net tassels hanging below. It was mounted on the Elephant Carriage.

sentences.zh: 大白，素質五幅，每幅繡熊一、虎一，側幅如之，下垂淺黃絲網緌五，革輅建之。

translations.literal: The Grand White had a plain white field of five panels, each panel embroidered with one bear and one tiger, with side panels likewise, and five pale yellow silk net tassels hanging below; it was mounted on the Leather Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand White had a plain white field of five panels, each embroidered with one bear and one tiger, with side panels likewise and five pale yellow silk net tassels hanging below. It was mounted on the Leather Carriage.

sentences.zh: 大麾，皂質四幅，每幅繡五采龜蛇一，側幅繡龜二，下垂皂絲網緌四，木輅建之。

translations.literal: The Great Command Banner had a black field of four panels, each panel embroidered with one five-colored tortoise and snake, with side panels embroidered with two tortoises, and four black silk net tassels hanging below; it was mounted on the Wood Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Command Banner had a black field of four panels, each embroidered with one five-colored tortoise and snake, with side panels embroidered with two tortoises and four black silk net tassels hanging below. It was mounted on the Wood Carriage.

sentences.zh: 其黃龍負圖旗，建隆初創為大製。

translations.literal: The Yellow Dragon Bearing the Diagram flag was first created on a large scale at the beginning of Jianlong.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Dragon Bearing the Diagram flag was first created on a large scale at the beginning of Jianlong.

sentences.zh: 有架，旗力重，以百九十人維之，今用七十人。

translations.literal: It had a frame; the flag was heavy and required one hundred ninety men to support it; now seventy men were used.
translations.idiomatic: It had a frame. The flag was so heavy that it once required one hundred ninety men to support it; now seventy men were used.

sentences.zh: 其君王萬歲、天下太平、日月、五星、北斗、招搖、青龍、朱雀、白虎、玄武等十旗，皆以十七人維之。

translations.literal: The ten flags May the Sovereign Live Ten Thousand Years, All Under Heaven at Peace, Sun and Moon, Five Stars, Northern Dipper, Twinkling Brilliance, Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, and Dark Warrior were all supported by seventeen men each.
translations.idiomatic: The ten flags May the Sovereign Live Ten Thousand Years, All Under Heaven at Peace, Sun and Moon, Five Stars, Northern Dipper, Twinkling Brilliance, Azure Dragon, Vermilion Bird, White Tiger, and Dark Warrior were each supported by seventeen men.

sentences.zh: 其祥瑞旗八，紹興二十五年所製也。

translations.literal: The eight auspicious omen flags were made in the twenty-fifth year of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: The eight auspicious omen flags were made in the twenty-fifth year of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，適當郊祀，而太廟生靈芝九莖，贛州進太平瑞木，道州連理木，遂寧府嘉禾，鎮江府瑞瓜，南安軍雙蓮花，嚴州兜率寺、信州玉山芝草，黎州甘露，禮部侍郎王瑉等請繪之華旗，以紀盛美焉。

translations.literal: That year, when the suburban sacrifice was held, nine stalks of spirit fungus grew in the Imperial Ancestral Temple; Gan Prefecture presented a Peace Auspicious Tree, Dao Prefecture presented joined trees, Suining Prefecture presented auspicious grain, Zhenjiang Prefecture presented an auspicious melon, Nan'an Circuit presented twin lotus flowers, Doushu Temple in Yan Prefecture and Yushan in Xin Prefecture presented spirit fungus, and Lizhou presented sweet dew. Vice Minister of Rites Wang Min and others requested that these be painted on splendid flags to record the glorious beauty.
translations.idiomatic: That year, when the suburban sacrifice was held, nine stalks of spirit fungus grew in the Imperial Ancestral Temple. Gan Prefecture presented a Peace Auspicious Tree, Dao Prefecture presented joined trees, Suining Prefecture presented auspicious grain, Zhenjiang Prefecture presented an auspicious melon, Nan'an Circuit presented twin lotus flowers, Doushu Temple in Yan Prefecture and Yushan in Xin Prefecture presented spirit fungus, and Lizhou presented sweet dew. Vice Minister of Rites Wang Min and others requested that these be painted on splendid flags to commemorate the glorious omens.

sentences.zh: 五牛旗，依方色，皆小輿上刻木為牛，背插旗。

translations.literal: The Five Ox flags, according to the colors of the directions, were all wooden oxen carved on small litters with flags inserted on their backs.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Ox flags, in the colors of the five directions, were all wooden oxen carved on small litters with flags inserted on their backs.

sentences.zh: 錯采為牛，旗竿上有小盤，盤衣及輿衣，亦並繡牛形。

translations.literal: The oxen were made in multi-colored weave; on the flag pole was a small disk, and both the disk covering and litter covering were also embroidered with ox shapes.
translations.idiomatic: The oxen were made in multi-colored weave. On the flag pole was a small disk, and both the disk covering and litter covering were also embroidered with ox shapes.

sentences.zh: 輿士各四人，服繡五色牛衣。

translations.literal: Each litter had four bearers, wearing embroidered five-colored ox garments.
translations.idiomatic: Each litter had four bearers who wore embroidered five-colored ox garments.

sentences.zh: 自太祖時詔用之。

translations.literal: From the time of Emperor Taizu an edict ordered their use.
translations.idiomatic: From the time of Emperor Taizu, an edict ordered their use.

sentences.zh: 神宗熙寧七年，太常寺言：“大駕鹵簿羊車，本前代宮中所乘；

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining under Emperor Shenzong, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "The sheep carriage in the grand imperial escort was originally ridden in the palace in former dynasties;"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xining, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "The sheep carriage in the grand imperial escort was originally used within the palace in former dynasties;"

sentences.zh: 五牛旗，蓋古之五時副車也，以木牛載旗，用人輿之，失其本製，宜省去。”

translations.literal: the Five Ox flags were probably the ancient five-season secondary carriages; flags were carried on wooden oxen and borne by men in litters, which departed from the original design and should be removed."
translations.idiomatic: the Five Ox flags were probably the ancient five-season secondary carriages. Flags were carried on wooden oxen and borne by men in litters, which departed from the original design and should be removed.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 牙門旗，古者，天子出建大牙。

translations.literal: The Gate Banner: in antiquity, when the Son of Heaven went out he erected the Great Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Banner: in antiquity, when the Son of Heaven went out he erected the Great Banner.

sentences.zh: 今製，赤質，錯采為神人象，中道前後各一門，左右道五門，門二旗，蓋取周製“樹旗表門”及“天子五門”之製。

translations.literal: The present design had a red field with multi-colored divine human figures; on the central road one gate before and one after, and on the left and right roads five gates each, with two flags per gate—adopting the Zhou practice of "planting flags to mark gates" and the "five gates of the Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: The present design had a red field with multi-colored divine human figures. On the central road there was one gate before and one after, and on the left and right roads five gates each, with two flags per gate, adopting the Zhou practice of planting flags to mark gates and the five gates of the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 駕頭，一名寶床，正衙法坐也。

translations.literal: The Imperial Headrest, also called the Precious Couch, was the formal seat of the main audience hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Headrest, also called the Precious Couch, was the formal seat used in the main audience hall.

sentences.zh: 香木為之，四足彖山，以龍卷之。

translations.literal: It was made of fragrant wood, with four legs shaped as mountains and entwined with dragons.
translations.idiomatic: It was made of fragrant wood, with four legs shaped as mountains and entwined with dragons.

sentences.zh: 坐麵用藤織雲龍，四圍錯采，繪走龍形，微曲。

translations.literal: The seat surface was woven of rattan with cloud-dragons; the four sides were multi-colored, painted with running dragon forms, slightly curved.
translations.idiomatic: The seat surface was woven of rattan with cloud-dragons. The four sides were multi-colored and painted with running dragon forms, slightly curved.

sentences.zh: 上加緋羅繡褥，裹以緋羅繡帕。

translations.literal: Above was added a scarlet silk embroidered cushion, wrapped in a scarlet silk embroidered cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Above it was placed a scarlet silk embroidered cushion, wrapped in a scarlet silk embroidered cloth.

sentences.zh: 每車駕出幸，則使老內臣馬上擁之，為前驅焉。

translations.literal: Whenever the imperial carriage went out on tour, an elderly inner palace eunuch was made to embrace it on horseback as a vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the imperial carriage went out on tour, an elderly inner palace eunuch rode ahead on horseback carrying it as a vanguard.

sentences.zh: 不設，則以朱匣韜之。

translations.literal: When not displayed, it was sheathed in a vermilion case.
translations.idiomatic: When not displayed, it was stored in a vermilion case.

sentences.zh: 幡，本幟也，貌幡幡然。

translations.literal: The pennant was originally a banner, named for its fluttering appearance.
translations.idiomatic: The pennant was originally a banner, named for its fluttering appearance.

sentences.zh: 有告止、傳教、信幡，皆絳帛，錯采為字，上有朱綠小蓋，四角垂羅文佩，係龍頭竿上。

translations.literal: There were Halt, Transmit Edict, and Trust pennants, all of crimson silk with multi-colored characters, with small vermilion and green canopies above and silk-patterned pendants hanging from the four corners, attached to dragon-head poles.
translations.idiomatic: There were Halt, Transmit Edict, and Trust pennants, all of crimson silk with multi-colored characters, with small vermilion and green canopies above and silk-patterned pendants hanging from the four corners, attached to dragon-head poles.

sentences.zh: 其錯采字下，告止為雙鳳，傳教為雙白虎，信幡為雙龍。

translations.literal: Below the multi-colored characters, Halt had paired phoenixes, Transmit Edict had paired white tigers, and Trust had paired dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Below the multi-colored characters, the Halt pennant bore paired phoenixes, the Transmit Edict pennant bore paired white tigers, and the Trust pennant bore paired dragons.

sentences.zh: 又有絳引幡，製頗同此，作五色間暈，無字，兩角垂佩。

translations.literal: There was also the crimson guide pennant, much the same in design, made with five-colored halos, without characters, with pendants hanging from the two corners.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the crimson guide pennant, much the same in design, made with five-colored halos and no characters, with pendants hanging from the two corners.

sentences.zh: 中興為六角蓋，垂珠佩，下有橫木板，作碾玉文。

translations.literal: After the Restoration it had a hexagonal canopy, pearl pendants, and below a horizontal wooden board with ground-jade patterns.
translations.idiomatic: After the Restoration it had a hexagonal canopy and pearl pendants, with a horizontal wooden board below bearing ground-jade patterns.

sentences.zh: 三幡，亦以錯采篆書“告止”、“傳教”、“信幡”。

translations.literal: The three pennants also bore in multi-colored seal script the words "Halt," "Transmit Edict," and "Trust Pennant."
translations.idiomatic: The three pennants also bore in multi-colored seal script the words "Halt," "Transmit Edict," and "Trust Pennant."

sentences.zh: 幢，製如節而五層，韜以袋，繡四神，隨方色，朱漆柄。

translations.literal: The banner-staff was made like a baton but with five layers, sheathed in a bag embroidered with the Four Deities in the colors of their directions, with a vermilion lacquered handle.
translations.idiomatic: The banner-staff was made like a baton but with five layers, sheathed in a bag embroidered with the Four Deities in the colors of their directions, with a vermilion lacquered handle.

sentences.zh: 取《曲禮》“行前朱雀而後玄武，左青龍而右白虎”之義。

translations.literal: It adopted the meaning of the "Qu Li": "Vermilion Bird in front and Dark Warrior behind, Azure Dragon on the left and White Tiger on the right."
translations.idiomatic: It adopted the meaning of the Qu Li: "Vermilion Bird in front and Dark Warrior behind, Azure Dragon on the left and White Tiger on the right."

sentences.zh: 王公所給幢，黑漆柄，紫綾袋。

translations.literal: The banner-staffs given to princes and dukes had black lacquered handles and purple silk bags.
translations.idiomatic: The banner-staffs given to princes and dukes had black lacquered handles and purple silk bags.

sentences.zh: 中興，用生色袋。

translations.literal: After the Restoration, undyed bags were used.
translations.idiomatic: After the Restoration, undyed bags were used.

sentences.zh: 皂纛，本後魏纛頭之製。

translations.literal: The black standard was originally the pennant-head design of Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: The black standard was originally the pennant-head design of Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 唐衛尉器用，纛居其一，蓋旄頭之遺象。

translations.literal: Among the implements of the Tang Guard Command, the standard was one item; it was probably a remnant image of the yak-tail standard.
translations.idiomatic: Among the implements of the Tang Guard Command, the standard was one item; it was probably a remnant form of the yak-tail standard.

sentences.zh: 製同旗，無文采，去鐏首六腳。

translations.literal: Its design was like a flag but without decorative patterns, lacking the metal finial and six streamers.
translations.idiomatic: Its design was like a flag but without decorative patterns, lacking the metal finial and six streamers.

sentences.zh: 《後志》云：“今製，皂邊皂斿，斿為火焰之形。”

translations.literal: The Later Treatise states: "The present design has black borders and black streamers; the streamers are in the shape of flames."
translations.idiomatic: The Later Treatise states: "The present design has black borders and black streamers shaped like flames."

sentences.zh: 金吾仗主之，每纛一人持，一人拓之。

translations.literal: The Golden Guard Staff Office was in charge; for each standard one man held it and one man spread it.
translations.idiomatic: The Golden Guard Staff Office was in charge. For each standard one man held it and one man spread it.

sentences.zh: 乘輿行，則陳於鹵簿，左右各六。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage traveled, they were arrayed in the escort, six on each side.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage traveled, they were arrayed in the escort, six on each side.

sentences.zh: 絳麾，如幢，止三層，紫羅囊蒙之。

translations.literal: The crimson command banner was like a banner-staff but with only three layers, covered with a purple silk bag.
translations.idiomatic: The crimson command banner was like a banner-staff but with only three layers, covered with a purple silk bag.

sentences.zh: 王公麾，以紫綾袋。

translations.literal: The command banners of princes and dukes used purple silk bags.
translations.idiomatic: The command banners of princes and dukes used purple silk bags.

sentences.zh: 黃麾，古有黃、朱、纁三色，所以指麾也。

translations.literal: The yellow command banner: in antiquity there were yellow, vermilion, and light red colors, used for giving commands.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow command banner: in antiquity there were yellow, vermilion, and light red colors, used for giving commands.

sentences.zh: 漢鹵簿有前黃麾護駕御史。

translations.literal: The Han imperial escort had a front yellow command banner with censor escorts.
translations.idiomatic: The Han imperial escort included a front yellow command banner with censor escorts.

sentences.zh: 宋製，絳帛為之，如幡，錯采成“黃麾’字，下繡交龍；

translations.literal: The Song design used crimson silk, like a pennant, with multi-colored characters forming the words "Yellow Command Banner," and interlaced dragons embroidered below;
translations.idiomatic: The Song design used crimson silk, like a pennant, with multi-colored characters forming the words "Yellow Command Banner," and interlaced dragons embroidered below;

sentences.zh: 朱漆竿，金龍首，上垂朱綠小蓋。

translations.literal: it had a vermilion lacquered pole, a golden dragon head, and a small vermilion and green canopy hanging above.
translations.idiomatic: it had a vermilion lacquered pole, a golden dragon head, and a small vermilion and green canopy hanging above.

sentences.zh: 神宗元豐二年，詳定朝會禦殿儀注所言：

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng under Emperor Shenzong, the office for determining court assembly and imperial hall ritual procedures stated:
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yuanfeng, the office charged with determining court assembly and imperial hall ritual procedures reported:

sentences.zh: 按《周禮》“木輅建大麾，以田”，鄭氏曰：“大麾不在九旗之中。

translations.literal: According to the "Rites of Zhou," "The Wood Carriage mounts the Great Command Banner for hunting." Master Zheng said: "The Great Command Banner is not among the Nine Banners."
translations.idiomatic: According to the Rites of Zhou, "The Wood Carriage mounts the Great Command Banner for hunting." Master Zheng said: "The Great Command Banner is not among the Nine Banners."

sentences.zh: 以正色言之，則黑，夏後氏所建。”

translations.literal: Speaking in terms of the orthodox color, it is black, and was established by the Xia dynasty."
translations.idiomatic: Speaking in terms of the orthodox color, it is black and was established by the Xia dynasty.

sentences.zh: 《禮記》曰：“有虞氏之旂，夏後氏緌。”

translations.literal: The "Record of Rites" says: "The banner of the Youyu clan, the tassels of the Xia dynasty."
translations.idiomatic: The Record of Rites says: "The banner of the Youyu clan, the tassels of the Xia dynasty."

sentences.zh: 鄭氏曰：“緌，謂注旄牛尾於杠首。

translations.literal: Master Zheng said: "Liu means fixing yak tails at the pole head."
translations.idiomatic: Master Zheng said: "Liu means fixing yak tails at the pole head."

sentences.zh: 所謂大麾，《書》曰‘王右秉白旄以麾’。”

translations.literal: What is called the Great Command Banner—the "Documents" says, "The king on the right holds a white yak-tail banner to command."
translations.idiomatic: What is called the Great Command Banner—the Documents says, "The king on the right holds a white yak-tail banner to command."

sentences.zh: 孔潁達曰：“虞世但注旄，夏世始加旒縿。”

translations.literal: Kong Yingda said: "In the Yu era only yak tails were fixed; in the Xia era tassels and fringe were first added."
translations.idiomatic: Kong Yingda said: "In the Yu era only yak tails were fixed; in the Xia era tassels and fringe were first added."

sentences.zh: 《西京雜記》，漢大駕有前黃麾。

translations.literal: The "Miscellaneous Records of the Western Capital" records that the Han grand procession had a front yellow command banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Miscellaneous Records of the Western Capital records that the Han grand procession had a front yellow command banner.

sentences.zh: 崔豹《古今注》：“麾，所以指麾，乘輿以黃，諸公以朱，刺史二千石以纁。”

translations.literal: Cui Bao's "Notes Ancient and Modern" states: "The command banner is used for giving commands; the imperial carriage uses yellow, feudal lords use vermilion, and prefects and two-thousand-bushel officials use light red."
translations.idiomatic: Cui Bao's Notes Ancient and Modern states: "The command banner is used for giving commands. The imperial carriage uses yellow, feudal lords use vermilion, and prefects and two-thousand-bushel officials use light red."

sentences.zh: 《開元禮義纂》曰：“唐太宗法夏後之前製，取中方之正色，故製大麾，色黃。”

translations.literal: The "Compendium of Kaiyuan Ritual Meanings" says: "Emperor Taizong of Tang followed the earlier design of the Xia dynasty, taking the orthodox color of the central direction, and therefore made the Great Command Banner yellow."
translations.idiomatic: The Compendium of Kaiyuan Ritual Meanings says: "Emperor Taizong of Tang followed the earlier design of the Xia dynasty, taking the orthodox color of the central direction, and therefore made the Great Command Banner yellow."

sentences.zh: 今禮有黃麾，其製十二幅。

translations.literal: Present ritual has the Yellow Command Banner, with a design of twelve panels.
translations.idiomatic: Present ritual includes the Yellow Command Banner, with a design of twelve panels.

sentences.zh: 《開寶通禮義纂》曰：“黃，中央之色。

translations.literal: The "Compendium of Kaibao Universal Ritual Meanings" says: "Yellow is the color of the center."
translations.idiomatic: The Compendium of Kaibao Universal Ritual Meanings says: "Yellow is the color of the center."

sentences.zh: 此仗最近車輅，故以應象，取其居中，導達四方，含光大也。”

translations.literal: This guard staff is nearest the imperial carriage, and therefore corresponds to the elephant, taking the center to guide and reach the four directions, containing and spreading great light."
translations.idiomatic: This guard staff is nearest the imperial carriage and therefore corresponds to the elephant, taking the center to guide the four directions and spread great light.

sentences.zh: 今鹵簿黃麾，以夏製言之，則狀不類旗；

translations.literal: The present Yellow Command Banner in the imperial escort, speaking in terms of the Xia design, does not resemble a flag in form;
translations.idiomatic: The present Yellow Command Banner in the imperial escort, speaking in terms of the Xia design, does not resemble a flag in form;

sentences.zh: 以漢製言之，則色又不黃。

translations.literal: speaking in terms of the Han design, its color is again not yellow.
translations.idiomatic: speaking in terms of the Han design, its color is again not yellow.

sentences.zh: 伏請製大麾一：注麾於竿首，則法夏後氏之製；

translations.literal: I respectfully request that one Great Command Banner be made: fixing the banner at the pole head would follow the Xia design;
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully request that one Great Command Banner be made. Fixing the banner at the pole head would follow the Xia design;

sentences.zh: 其色正黃，則用漢製；

translations.literal: making its color true yellow would use the Han design;
translations.idiomatic: making its color true yellow would follow the Han design;

sentences.zh: 以十二幅為旗，則取唐製；

translations.literal: making it a flag of twelve panels would take the Tang design;
translations.idiomatic: making it a flag of twelve panels would follow the Tang design;

sentences.zh: 以一旒為之，則取今龍墀旗之製。

translations.literal: making it with one tassel would take the present Dragon Court flag design.
translations.idiomatic: making it with one tassel would follow the present Dragon Court flag design.

sentences.zh: 當元會陳仗衛，建大黃麾一於當禦廂之前，以為表識。

translations.literal: When the New Year's assembly displayed guard formations, one Great Yellow Command Banner would be erected before the imperial box as a marker.
translations.idiomatic: When the New Year's assembly displayed guard formations, one Great Yellow Command Banner would be erected before the imperial box as a marker.

sentences.zh: 其當禦廂之後，則建黃麾幡二。

translations.literal: Behind the imperial box, two Yellow Command Banner pennants would be erected.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the imperial box, two Yellow Command Banner pennants would be erected.

sentences.zh: 並上大黃麾、黃麾幡制度。

translations.literal: The regulations for the Great Yellow Command Banner and Yellow Command Banner pennants were submitted together.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations for the Great Yellow Command Banner and Yellow Command Banner pennants were submitted together.

sentences.zh: 神宗批曰：“黃麾制度，考詳前誌，終是可疑。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong annotated: "The Yellow Command Banner regulations, though examined in detail against earlier records, remain doubtful."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong annotated: "The Yellow Command Banner regulations, though examined in detail against earlier records, remain doubtful."

sentences.zh: 今鑿而為之，植於大庭中外共瞻之地，或為博聞多識者所譏。

translations.literal: If we now force their creation and plant them in the great hall where all within and without can see, we may be mocked by the learned and knowledgeable.
translations.idiomatic: If we now force their creation and plant them in the great hall where all within and without can see, we may be mocked by the learned and knowledgeable.

sentences.zh: 宜且闕之，更俟討求，黃麾幡仍舊。”

translations.literal: It is best to leave the matter aside for now and await further research; the Yellow Command Banner pennants should remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: It is best to leave the matter aside for now and await further research. The Yellow Command Banner pennants should remain as before.

sentences.zh: 氅，本緝鳥毛為之。

translations.literal: The canopy was originally made by stitching bird feathers together.
translations.idiomatic: The canopy was originally made by stitching bird feathers together.

sentences.zh: 唐有六色、孔雀、大小鵝毛、雞毛之製。

translations.literal: The Tang had designs in six colors, peacock, large and small goose feathers, and chicken feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang had designs in six colors, as well as peacock, large and small goose feathers, and chicken feathers.

sentences.zh: 《後志》云：“今製有青、緋、皂、白、黃五色，上有朱蓋，下垂帶，帶繡禽羽，末綴金鈴。

translations.literal: The Later Treatise states: "The present design has five colors—green, scarlet, black, white, and yellow—with a vermilion canopy above, hanging bands below embroidered with bird feathers, and gold bells at the ends."
translations.idiomatic: The Later Treatise states: "The present design has five colors—green, scarlet, black, white, and yellow—with a vermilion canopy above, hanging bands below embroidered with bird feathers, and gold bells at the ends."

sentences.zh: 青則繡以孔雀，五角蓋；

translations.literal: Green was embroidered with peacocks and had a five-cornered canopy;
translations.idiomatic: Green was embroidered with peacocks and had a five-cornered canopy;

sentences.zh: 緋則繡以鳳，六角蓋；

translations.literal: scarlet was embroidered with phoenixes and had a six-cornered canopy;
translations.idiomatic: scarlet was embroidered with phoenixes and had a six-cornered canopy;

sentences.zh: 皂則繡以鵝，六角蓋；

translations.literal: black was embroidered with geese and had a six-cornered canopy;
translations.idiomatic: black was embroidered with geese and had a six-cornered canopy;

sentences.zh: 白亦以鵝，四角蓋；

translations.literal: white also used geese and had a four-cornered canopy;
translations.idiomatic: white also used geese and had a four-cornered canopy;

sentences.zh: 黃則以雞，四角蓋。

translations.literal: yellow used chickens and had a four-cornered canopy.
translations.idiomatic: yellow used chickens and had a four-cornered canopy.

sentences.zh: 每角綴垂佩，揭以朱竿，上如戟，加橫木龍首以係之。”

translations.literal: Each corner had hanging pendants; it was raised on a vermilion pole shaped like a halberd at the top, with a crossbar and dragon head added to attach it.
translations.idiomatic: Each corner had hanging pendants. It was raised on a vermilion pole shaped like a halberd at the top, with a crossbar and dragon head added to attach it.

sentences.zh: 金節，隋製也。

translations.literal: The gold baton was a Sui design.
translations.idiomatic: The gold baton was a Sui design.

sentences.zh: 黑漆竿，上施圓盤，周綴紅絲拂八層，黃繡龍袋籠之。

translations.literal: It had a black lacquered pole with a round disk mounted above, eight layers of red silk tassels hung around it, and a yellow embroidered dragon bag enclosing it.
translations.idiomatic: It had a black lacquered pole with a round disk mounted above, eight layers of red silk tassels hung around it, and a yellow embroidered dragon bag enclosing it.

sentences.zh: 王公以下皆有節，製同金節，韜以碧油。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and those below all had batons of the same design as the gold baton, sheathed in green lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, dukes, and those below all had batons of the same design as the gold baton, sheathed in green lacquer.

sentences.zh: 傘，古張帛避雨之製。

translations.literal: The umbrella was the ancient design of spreading cloth to avoid rain.
translations.idiomatic: The umbrella was the ancient design of spreading cloth to avoid rain.

sentences.zh: 今有方傘、大傘，皆赤質，紫表朱裏，四角銅螭首。

translations.literal: Now there are square umbrellas and large umbrellas, all with red fields, purple outside and vermilion inside, with copper dragon heads at the four corners.
translations.idiomatic: Now there are square umbrellas and large umbrellas, all with red fields, purple outside and vermilion inside, with copper dragon heads at the four corners.

sentences.zh: 六引內者，其製差小。

translations.literal: Those within the Six Guides were somewhat smaller in design.
translations.idiomatic: Those within the Six Guides were somewhat smaller in design.

sentences.zh: 哲宗元祐七年，太常寺言：《開元禮》大駕八角紫傘，王公已下四角青傘。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanyou under Emperor Zhezong, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: The Kaiyuan Rites prescribe an octagonal purple umbrella for the grand procession and four-cornered green umbrellas for princes, dukes, and those below.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yuanyou, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: The Kaiyuan Rites prescribe an octagonal purple umbrella for the grand procession and four-cornered green umbrellas for princes, dukes, and those below.

sentences.zh: 今《鹵簿圖》但引紫傘，而無青傘之文。

translations.literal: The present Imperial Escort Diagram cites only the purple umbrella and has no mention of green umbrellas.
translations.idiomatic: The present Imperial Escort Diagram cites only the purple umbrella and has no mention of green umbrellas.

sentences.zh: 詔改用。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the change to be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the change to be adopted.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年將郊，詔傘、扇如舊制，拂扇等不以珠飾。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, when the suburban sacrifice was imminent, an edict ordered umbrellas and fans to follow the old design, and feathered fans and the like were not to use pearl ornamentation.
